excerpt: Employers: If you disagree with our decision about your unemployment taxes, you can appeal that decision.
Avoid penalties for not paying your unemployment taxes or filing your quarterly report on time. In some cases, you can ask us to waive a penalty.
Employers and firms that represent employers can manage many tasks in eServices. Learn how to create an account and combine eServices with the Employer Account Management System (EAMS).
Unemployment tax rates for employers change every year. See the current tax rates and learn how we set them.
Employers may need to submit supporting documents or details to help us review the claimant’s eligibility.
Find resources to help you prevent layoffs, support employees during an unavoidable layoff and understand notification requirements for mass layoffs.
You may file your quarterly tax and wage reports online or by mail. Filing online reduces errors.
If you do not have an EAMS account, watch this 3-minute video for a step-by-step guide to setting up an account.
Watch this 2-minute video to learn how to add an employer in EAMS.
Log into SecureAccess Washington (SAW) to access EAMS and make changes to your quarterly report.
Complete an amended tax and wage report form (PDF, 138KB). Submit it by email, mail or fax.
If you are a new employer or filed your last quarterly report on paper, we send you paper quarterly report forms. Otherwise, you need to ask us to mail paper forms to you.
Watch this 2-minute video for a step-by-step guide to filing a no-payroll report in EAMS.
If your tax account had no wages to report for a year or less, and you have wages to report again, we can reactivate your account.
Did you know you can work part time and still get partial unemployment benefits?
the Paid Family & Medical Leave (Paid Leave) program provides eligible workers with the opportunity to take paid time off for various family and personal medical reasons.
